overview_description.description:
ProvenMetal builds circuit boards in the United States.

We turn boards in five days as standard, with instant quoting. You send your manufacturing files, and we ship the board to you as fast as possible. 

Assembly, inspection, and verification all run on a line we own and operate in the United States. Currently in private beta.
